source: π¹ Gruis, VLTI/PIONIER, nights of 25/26 and 29/30 September 2014 (ESO programme 093.D-0598, Paladini et al. 2018), the calibrated visibilities in observations/PI_GRU_forImage.fits

fit.data: the calibrated PIONIER visibilities of π¹ Gruis, inside the first lobe

band: VLTI/PIONIER H band (1.5-1.8 um); not a visible band

alpha.cell: alpha 1.29 (1.18 to 1.39 with the diameter refitted), limb-darkened diameter 21.38 mas, reduced chi-squared 5.97 over the 341 squared visibilities shorter than the first null of the 18.17 mas uniform disc; the uncertainty is the larger side

note: No paper publishes a limb law for this star and no model grid reaches it. The first lobe is where the whole disc dominates; past it the surface structure does, and a law fitted there measures the structure, not the limb.
